objective: Record explicit owner authorization for full local REST scopes and observed Plus custom app availability.

roles_before.artifact: Hermes, TickTick and ChatGPT queue owners

role_dispositions.destination: Hermes, TickTick and ChatGPT queue owners

capability_probes.assertion: Existing Oracle Phoenix Admin is installed in the Plus account and its permission reads Allow all.
Unauthenticated REST remains HTTP 401 after granting owner scopes to the local key.
Workflow and execution REST reads return HTTP 200 with the same key.
Existing n8n backup service successfully ran following the scope update; earlier scope state is documented in Git.

tests.command: Owner UI REST scope list and independent credential-only REST GET /users and /credentials
tests.expected: All 109 supported scopes are present; both calls return HTTP 200.

tests.command: Read workflow and execution lists with the same key, and call users without credentials.
tests.expected: Authorized calls HTTP 200 and anonymous call HTTP 401.

known_intentional_losses: The root-only REST key now has owner scopes by explicit authorization.
